dialogues.jp: 「さいこーですか？」
dialogues.en: "Should I get up...?"
dialogues.text: "Should I get up...?"

dialogues.jp: 疑問形でまったり。
dialogues.en: I sleepily questioned myself.
dialogues.text: I sleepily questioned myself.

dialogues.jp: 布団に鼻まで潜り、深く息を吐く。
dialogues.en: My nose was still buried in my bed, breathing deeply.
dialogues.text: My nose was still buried in my bed, breathing deeply.

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましにも義妹にも邪魔されず、こうして布
団の中でうだうだしているのはなんとも心地が
良い。
dialogues.en:
Nemu already left earlier in the morning, and being in this
bed feels so good...
dialogues.text:
Nemu already left earlier in the morning, and being in this
bed feels so good...

dialogues.jp:
何より、もう日も昇っているであろうこの時間
なら、かったるい夢も滅多に見ない。
dialogues.en:
I also usually don't have those troublesome dreams after the
sun rises...
dialogues.text:
I also usually don't have those troublesome dreams after the
sun rises...

dialogues.jp: 俺は安心して夢と｛うつつ／現｝の境い目をただよっていた。
dialogues.en:
I calmly left myself on the border of consciousness and
dreamland.
dialogues.text:
I calmly left myself on the border of consciousness and
dreamland.

dialogues.jp:
ああ、たとえ世間から自堕落と言われようが、
できることならこうして一日中、この甘美な
｛けんたい／倦怠｝に包まれていたい。
dialogues.en:
Ahh, being able to escape the depravity and evilness of the
world for just a few hours is so sweet.
dialogues.text:
Ahh, being able to escape the depravity and evilness of the
world for just a few hours is so sweet.

dialogues.jp:
……するとそんな俺の怠惰を叱咤するかのよう
に電話のベルが鳴り響いた。
dialogues.en:
...Until, as if to punish my laziness, the telephone started
ringing.
dialogues.text:
...Until, as if to punish my laziness, the telephone started
ringing.

dialogues.jp: ……気のせいだ。俺には何も聞こえない。
dialogues.en: ...Just my imagination. Didn't hear anything.
dialogues.text: ...Just my imagination. Didn't hear anything.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえない。
dialogues.en: I can't hear.
dialogues.text: I can't hear.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえないぞ。
dialogues.en: I can't hear you.
dialogues.text: I can't hear you.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえないったら聞こえな――。
dialogues.en: I can't hear you means I can't hear!
dialogues.text: I can't hear you means I can't hear!

dialogues.jp:
しかし――電話のベルは１０コールをカウント
した後も一向に鳴り止む気配を見せない。
dialogues.en:
But-- after 10 rings, the blaring rings still showed no
signs of stopping.
dialogues.text:
But-- after 10 rings, the blaring rings still showed no
signs of stopping.

dialogues.jp:
「……キミの要求はわかった。おとなしく従お
　う」
dialogues.en: "....Fine, fine, I'll abide by your orders."
dialogues.text: "....Fine, fine, I'll abide by your orders."

dialogues.jp:
根負けした俺は、電話の向こうにいる「誰か」
へ降伏宣言をして、のろのろとベッドを這い出
した。
dialogues.en:
With my declaration of surrender, I dragged myself out of
bed and answered the phone.
dialogues.text:
With my declaration of surrender, I dragged myself out of
bed and answered the phone.

dialogues.jp: 「朝倉です」
dialogues.en: "Asakura residence."
dialogues.text: "Asakura residence."

dialogues.jp:
安らかなひとときを邪魔された｛いらだ／苛立｝ちから、ひ
とりでに不機嫌な声が出てしまう。
dialogues.en: I answered the phone with more than a hint of irritance.
dialogues.text: I answered the phone with more than a hint of irritance.

dialogues.jp:
『なんだ、いたのか。あんまり出ないからどっ
　か行ってるんだと思ったよ』
dialogues.en: "Wow, you did it. I thought you weren't going to answer."
dialogues.text: "Wow, you did it. I thought you weren't going to answer."

dialogues.jp:
聞きなれた、呆れたような声が受話器から聞こ
えてきた。この声は……。
dialogues.en:
On the other end of the phone, was a slightly amazed voice.
It belonged to...
dialogues.text:
On the other end of the phone, was a slightly amazed voice.
It belonged to...

dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、工藤か……こんな朝っぱらから何の
　用だ？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, it's you, Kudou... what did you call so early in the
morning for?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, it's you, Kudou... what did you call so early in the
morning for?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『朝って………………もう二時だぞ』
dialogues.en: "Early in the morning... it's two already."
dialogues.text: "Early in the morning... it's two already."

dialogues.jp: ツッコミ担当の悪友、工藤だった。
dialogues.en: Playing the tsukkomi as always, this Kudou.
dialogues.text: Playing the tsukkomi as always, this Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の言葉に時計を見ると、なるほど午後も二
時を大分回っている。
dialogues.en:
I checked the clock at Kudou's words, and sure enough, it
was well past 2 PM.
dialogues.text:
I checked the clock at Kudou's words, and sure enough, it
was well past 2 PM.

dialogues.jp:
「俺はまだ起きて飯も食ってないから、まだ朝
　なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"As long as it's the time between waking up and eating
breakfast, it's still morning."
dialogues.text:
"As long as it's the time between waking up and eating
breakfast, it's still morning."

dialogues.jp:
そう、誰が何と言おうと、俺の朝は起床後メシ
を喰ってからはじめて始まるのだ。
dialogues.en:
Right. No matter what anyone else says, my morning only
begins when breakfast is over.
dialogues.text:
Right. No matter what anyone else says, my morning only
begins when breakfast is over.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『……自堕落もいいとこだな』
dialogues.en: "...You're really something."
dialogues.text: "...You're really something."

dialogues.jp: いよいよ呆れ返ったような溜息混じりの声。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's half-sigh, half-talking had exasperation written
over it.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's half-sigh, half-talking had exasperation written
over it.

dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ、で、何の用だ？」
dialogues.en: "Whatever. What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Whatever. What's up?"

dialogues.jp:
俺としては、この生活態度を改めるつもりはあ
まりない。
dialogues.en:
He, of all people, should know it's impossible to change my
lifestyle.
dialogues.text:
He, of all people, should know it's impossible to change my
lifestyle.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、度を超すと音夢が口をきいてくれなくな
るので、その場合は無論例外だが……。
dialogues.en: At least, until it comes to a certain sister of mine...
dialogues.text: At least, until it comes to a certain sister of mine...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『えーと……お前、今日何か予定入ってるの
　か？』
dialogues.en: "Erm... do you have any plans for today?"
dialogues.text: "Erm... do you have any plans for today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だらだらと過ごす予定」
dialogues.en: "Besides vegetating, no."
dialogues.text: "Besides vegetating, no."

dialogues.jp:
決まった予定があったら｛さすが／流石｝にこんなに寝こけ
てはいない。
dialogues.en:
If I had something to do, obivously I wouldn't have slept
this late...
dialogues.text:
If I had something to do, obivously I wouldn't have slept
this late...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『そっか、ならさ………………映画観に行かな
　いか？』
dialogues.en: "Okay, then... do you want to catch a movie?"
dialogues.text: "Okay, then... do you want to catch a movie?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「これからか？　また随分急な話だな」
dialogues.en: "Now? That's pretty short notice."
dialogues.text: "Now? That's pretty short notice."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『本屋で貰った割引チケット見たらさ、期限が
　ちょうど今日までだったんだよ。勿体ないか
　らさ』
dialogues.en:
"I got two tickets as a rebate from a bookstore, and it's
only good for today. I don't want to waste them."
dialogues.text:
"I got two tickets as a rebate from a bookstore, and it's
only good for today. I don't want to waste them."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だったら、彼女でも誘えばいいじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "That's something one should be asking their girlfriend."
dialogues.text: "That's something one should be asking their girlfriend."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『……俺にそんなもんが居たら、朝倉に電話し
　てると思うか？』
dialogues.en:
"...Do you think I'd be calling you now if such a person
existed?"
dialogues.text:
"...Do you think I'd be calling you now if such a person
existed?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃそうだな、悪かった」
dialogues.en: "Oh, right, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oh, right, sorry."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか工藤への親密度が俺の中で急にアップ
したぞ。
dialogues.en: I didn't think Kudou felt this close to me though.
dialogues.text: I didn't think Kudou felt this close to me though.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『何人かクラスの奴にも声かけてみたんだけど
　……みんな彼女と旅行とか、デートとかでさ』
dialogues.en:
"More sensitive people would know not to talk about these
kind of things..."
dialogues.text:
"More sensitive people would know not to talk about these
kind of things..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『で、お前だったら確実に暇を持て余してるだ
　ろうなと思って』
dialogues.en: "But I guess I can't expect the same from you."
dialogues.text: "But I guess I can't expect the same from you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……でっかいお世話だ」
dialogues.en: "...That's harsh."
dialogues.text: "...That's harsh."

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、その勘は当たってた訳なのだが。
dialogues.en: Although it's really quite accurate.
dialogues.text: Although it's really quite accurate.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『で、どうなんだ？　今からなら２時４０分の
　回に間に合うけど』
dialogues.en: "So, can you? We should be able to catch the 2:40 PM show."
dialogues.text: "So, can you? We should be able to catch the 2:40 PM show."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ん〜……どーすっかな〜〜」
dialogues.en: "Hm... let's see..."
dialogues.text: "Hm... let's see..."

dialogues.jp:
出かけるには服も替えなきゃいけないし、顔も
洗わなきゃいけないし……。
dialogues.en: I'd have to change my clothes, and wash my face...
dialogues.text: I'd have to change my clothes, and wash my face...

dialogues.jp: 考えるだに、かったるい。
dialogues.en: Sounds kinda troublesome.
dialogues.text: Sounds kinda troublesome.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『お前、暇なんだろ？』
dialogues.en: "You've got nothing to do, right?"
dialogues.text: "You've got nothing to do, right?"

dialogues.jp: 答えない俺に、工藤は畳み掛ける。
dialogues.en: Kudou continued pressing for an answer from me.
dialogues.text: Kudou continued pressing for an answer from me.

dialogues.jp: ＯＫ、認めよう。確かに、暇は暇だ。
dialogues.en: Alright, I will. Free time is free time.
dialogues.text: Alright, I will. Free time is free time.

dialogues.jp: 「……一応聞いとくが、どんな映画なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...What kind of movie is it, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "...What kind of movie is it, anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『春休みに相応しい爽やかな恋愛モノだ』
dialogues.en:
"As usual for spring, the season of love, it's a romance
movie."
dialogues.text:
"As usual for spring, the season of love, it's a romance
movie."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それを俺達二人で観る、と？」
dialogues.en: "A, and, we're gonna watch that?"
dialogues.text: "A, and, we're gonna watch that?"

dialogues.jp: それはあまりに不毛な行為ではあるまいか？
dialogues.en: That doesn't sound right somehow...
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound right somehow...

dialogues.jp:
俺の心情を察したのか工藤がさりげなく付け足
す。
dialogues.en: Sensing my uneasiness, Kudou quickly chimed in again.
dialogues.text: Sensing my uneasiness, Kudou quickly chimed in again.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『帰りに、俺が飯おごってやるからさ』
dialogues.en: "On the way back, I'd treat you to a meal."
dialogues.text: "On the way back, I'd treat you to a meal."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……どこにでもお付き合いさせて頂きます」
dialogues.en: "...Wherever you wish to go, my friend."
dialogues.text: "...Wherever you wish to go, my friend."

dialogues.jp:
気付けば工藤には見えないというのに、反射的
に腰を屈めて揉み手をしている俺。
dialogues.en: Invisible to Kudou, I was already rubbing my belly in glee.
dialogues.text: Invisible to Kudou, I was already rubbing my belly in glee.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『ったく、分かりやすい奴だ』
dialogues.en: "Hah, you're so easy to manipulate."
dialogues.text: "Hah, you're so easy to manipulate."

dialogues.jp: 電話の向こうで、工藤が苦笑を漏らす。
dialogues.en: Kudou was laughing lightly on the other end of the phone.
dialogues.text: Kudou was laughing lightly on the other end of the phone.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『じゃ、映画館の前で待ってるぞ。現地集合っ
　てことでな』
dialogues.en:
"Alright, we'd meet at the movie theatre. I'd be waiting
there."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, we'd meet at the movie theatre. I'd be waiting
there."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「うーす」
dialogues.en: "Gotcha."
dialogues.text: "Gotcha."

dialogues.jp:
受話器を置いた俺は、改めて己の姿を眺めてみ
た。もう陽も高いというのにパジャマ姿のボサ
ボサ頭。
dialogues.en:
After placing the receiver back in it's place, I took
another look at myself in the mirror. Pajamas and fuzzy
hair.
dialogues.text:
After placing the receiver back in it's place, I took
another look at myself in the mirror. Pajamas and fuzzy
hair.

dialogues.jp:
（出かけるとなると、いくら何でも着替えない
　とな……）
dialogues.en: "(At least changing your clothes when you go out...)"
dialogues.text: "(At least changing your clothes when you go out...)"

dialogues.jp: それが人間として最低限のマナーというものか。
dialogues.en: That's the bare minimum of polite manners that humans show.
dialogues.text: That's the bare minimum of polite manners that humans show.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったるいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...How troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...How troublesome."

dialogues.jp: 取りあえず顔を洗うため、俺は部屋を後にした。
dialogues.en: I return to my room to watch my face.
dialogues.text: I return to my room to watch my face.

dialogues.jp: ◆まったり三昧◆
dialogues.en: ◆Awaited Concentration◆
dialogues.text: ◆Awaited Concentration◆

dialogues.jp: 休日、しつこく鳴り響く電話で起こされた。
dialogues.en:
On a holiday, I was woken up by the constant ringing of the
telephone.
dialogues.text:
On a holiday, I was woken up by the constant ringing of the
telephone.

dialogues.jp:
電話は工藤から、映画に行かないかという誘い
だった。
dialogues.en: It was Kudou, inviting me to watch a movie wtih him.
dialogues.text: It was Kudou, inviting me to watch a movie wtih him.

dialogues.jp: ジャンルはというと恋愛ものらしい。
dialogues.en: The genre was apparently going to be romance.
dialogues.text: The genre was apparently going to be romance.

dialogues.jp:
恋愛映画を男と観に行くのは不毛だと、一度は
断った俺だが、飯をおごるからと言う一言に、
結局あっさりと屈服したのだった。
dialogues.en:
I had uneasy feelings about watching a romance movie with a
guy, and was going to reject it, but Kudou's offer of food
after brought me around.
dialogues.text:
I had uneasy feelings about watching a romance movie with a
guy, and was going to reject it, but Kudou's offer of food
after brought me around.
